sidebarOpacity.title: Sidebar opacity
sidebarOpacity.description: Percentage of Inkdrop's own acrylic opacity for the sidebar. 100 keeps the Inkdrop default, lower is more see-through, higher is more solid.

noteListOpacity.title: Note list opacity
noteListOpacity.description: Percentage of Inkdrop's own acrylic opacity for the note list. 100 keeps the Inkdrop default.

editorOpacity.title: Editor opacity
editorOpacity.description: Percentage of Inkdrop's own acrylic opacity for the editor area. 100 keeps the Inkdrop default.

menuOpacity.title: Menu and dropdown opacity
menuOpacity.description: Percentage of the opacity Inkdrop uses for menus, dropdowns and the editor drawer. These are opaque by default so they stay readable; lower this only if you want them translucent too.
